description: Rutas GTFS_routes is a dataset listed in Dades Obertes FGC open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya (FGC). Define las rutas de transporte de FGC en formato GTFS. Una ruta es un grupo de viajes que se muestra a los pasajeros como un solo servicio. Para más información sobre el formato GTFS consultar:. Coverage: Catalonia (Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya network). The portal files it under Itinerarios y horarios, Turismo. Its keywords are gtfs, rutas. The portal shows 22 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution License 4.0 (cc-by 4.0) (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-dadesobertes-fgc-cat-portal.
